method: The entry list is split on line breaks, whitespace-collapsed, stripped of control characters, and deduplicated case-insensitively. Each card independently shuffles a copy of that list with a Fisher–Yates shuffle and takes the first n²−1 entries when a free centre is used, filling the grid row by row and reserving the middle cell. A new card is reshuffled up to 60 times if its ordered layout matches an earlier card, so repeats are possible only when the list cannot produce a different arrangement. The call list is a separate shuffle of every unique entry. Randomness comes from crypto.getRandomValues with a Math.random fallback; nothing is stored, uploaded, or sent. The generator does not check spelling or meaning, does not weight entries, and cannot guarantee a winning card.
